user.title: Connect the Telegram gateway
user.description: telegram-gateway address and GATEWAY_TOKEN (see the gateway .env).

error.no_account: The gateway has no logged-in Telegram account

make_call.name: Call
make_call.description: Place a voice or video call to a Telegram user.

peer.name: Callee (@username or +phone)
peer.description: @username or +phone number (with country code; the person must allow being found by number). Use instead of the numeric ID.

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: Telegram user ID of the callee.

mic.name: Mic
mic.description: Override the default mic (camera or Assist satellite, e.g. an R1 speaker).

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.description: Override the default speaker (R1 speaker or Imou/Dahua camera) that plays the other side.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Speaker volume 1-100 % while on the call, restored afterwards. 0 or empty = use the default / leave the speaker alone.
